```{r}
install.packages(c(
  "httr2",
  "jsonlite",
  "dplyr",
  "purrr",
  "tidyr",
  "ggplot2",
  "arrow"
))
```

```{r}
# R/01_get_session.R

library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)

sessions <- fromJSON(
  "https://api.openf1.org/v1/sessions?year=2023"
)

names(sessions)

sessions %>%
  filter(country_name == "Monaco") %>%
  select(
    session_key,
    country_name,
    session_name,
    date_start
  )
```

Vuelta rapida por piloto

```{r}
library(dplyr)

best_laps <- laps %>%
  filter(!is.na(lap_duration)) %>%
  group_by(driver_number) %>%
  summarise(
    best_lap = min(lap_duration)
  ) %>%
  arrange(best_lap)

best_laps
```
